description: This file defines the implementation of the RootCanal class, which is a command source for launching and managing the root canal process within the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment. It sets up commands for starting the root canal, port forwarding via vsock proxies, and integrates with the dependency injection framework.

classes.name: RootCanal
classes.description: A command source class responsible for launching and managing the root canal process, including port forwarding and process restart logic.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates a list of commands to start the root canal process and associated port forwarding proxies, with logging.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this command source, 'RootCanal'.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Determines if the root canal command source should be enabled based on configuration flags.
